title: Jubilant Smoky German Bananas Skillet
description: A one-pot German dish featuring fried ripe bananas with a smoky flavor, this recipe is gluten-free friendly and perfect for a snack or dessert. The combination of briny and flaky textures creates a delightful experience.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat and cook the diced smoked bacon until crispy.
Remove the bacon from the skillet and set aside on a paper towel-lined plate.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced bananas to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until caramelized.
In a small bowl, whisk together the potato starch, eggs, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the egg mixture over the bananas and onions in the skillet.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the eggs are set.
Return the cooked bacon to the skillet and stir to combine.
Serve the Jubilant Smoky German Bananas Skillet hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
